note: Unlike prompts.json (routing: does the skill fire?), these assert on the CONTENT of the produced output. Assume plain-speak is already invoked. A grader runs each case's prompt through the skill, then marks every assertion pass/fail against the produced text. Primary target: the 具體度 (concrete-over-abstract) guardrail added in v1.3.0 and its independence from the reader-relative why criterion. `ref` points at the SKILL.md anchor each assertion defends so a future guardrail edit that regresses shows up as a specific failing assertion.

evals.prompt: 幫我翻成給非技術主管的白話:「這次改動全面優化了系統穩定性,大幅提升使用者體驗,整體效能有顯著成長。」
evals.note: Adversarial: the source is ALL empty adjectives with zero concrete facts. 具體度 must not become a license to invent numbers. The correct move is to surface that there is no concrete fact to convey and ask/flag, not fabricate one.

assertions.must: Does NOT invent specific metrics, percentages, or before/after numbers that are absent from the source.
assertions.ref: Guardrails: 具體優先於抽象 + Accuracy outranks simplicity

assertions.must: Explicitly surfaces that the source is all abstraction with no concrete fact behind it — e.g. names the empty phrases or asks what actually changed (what/how much) — rather than dressing the same vagueness in different words.
assertions.ref: Guardrails: 具體優先於抽象 + Flag ambiguity, don't guess

assertions.must: Contains none of 白話講/白話來說/說白了/簡單來說/講白一點.

evals.prompt: 翻成白話給產品經理:「我們加了一層 Redis 快取,查詢的 p99 延遲從 2.1 秒降到 180 毫秒。」
evals.note: Facts ARE present. 具體度 means carrying the checkable number through, not softening it into 「大幅變快」. Also tests gloss + reader-relative why on top.

assertions.must: Preserves the concrete before/after figures (≈2.1s → ≈180ms, or ~10x/一秒多降到不到 0.2 秒). Does NOT replace them with only a vague 「大幅提升/變快很多」 that drops the number.
States the consequence for a PM (e.g. page/response feels near-instant, fewer users bounce), distinct from merely restating the latency drop.
assertions.ref: How to respond 3: Why it matters

assertions.must: p99 and Redis are each glossed inline (or replaced by the plain idea with the term as a parenthetical), not left carrying the sentence.
assertions.ref: Guardrails: No unglossed acronyms or jargon

evals.prompt: 幫我看這段給業務主管的白話夠不夠白:「我們把資料庫索引從 B-tree 換成 GIN,單次查詢掃描的資料頁從 12000 頁降到 340 頁。」
evals.note: Misdiagnosis guard. The draft carries a hard number (12000→340 pages) but it is the WRONG fact for a 業務主管 — a database-page count they cannot verify or act on — and the draft states no business consequence and is jargon-dense. The trap this guards against: because v1.3.0 added a 具體度 criterion, a reviewer might reflexively diagnose 'not concrete enough / add a number' when the draft already HAS a number; the real failures are reader-why and gloss. Insight this case encodes: 具體度 is not fully orthogonal to reader-relevance — 'checkable' carries an implicit 'by whom', so a figure can be concrete-in-form yet the wrong fact for this reader. The guard is correct attribution, not perfect independence. (Earlier draft ended in a vague 「少很多」 and an earlier note over-claimed clean independence — both fixed.)

assertions.must: The review does NOT diagnose the core problem as 'missing a concrete fact / add a number'. It recognizes a checkable figure is already present — 具體度 marked ✓, or △ noting the number is the wrong fact for this reader. A flat 具體度 ✗ that reads as 'needs a number' is a fail (the draft already has one).
assertions.ref: Reviewing a draft: 具體度 criterion

assertions.must: The draft's real failures are attributed to reader-relative why (✗: no business consequence a sales lead could use) AND unglossed jargon (✗) — not to absence of concreteness. This shows 具體度 sharpens the diagnosis rather than absorbing or masking the reader-why judgment.
assertions.ref: Reviewing a draft: Reader-relative why criterion

assertions.must: Flags B-tree / GIN / bitmap scan as unglossed terms of art carrying the meaning.
assertions.ref: Guardrails: No unglossed acronyms or jargon

assertions.must: Output is a flat marked checklist plus a corrected draft, not a blind rewrite.

evals.prompt: 翻成白話給主管:我們這次調了 12 個參數,包含 connection pool 從 20 開到 50、timeout 從 5 秒改 30 秒、retry 從 3 次改 5 次、batch size 從 100 改到 500,還有其他 8 項,結果整體吞吐量翻了一倍。
evals.note: Detail overflow. The v1.3.0 guardrail says the fix is representative-concrete (pick the 1-2 facts that carry it), NOT exhaustive-concrete (dump all 12) and NOT going abstract. Also stresses that 具體 and 精煉 hold together: rewrite must not be longer than the original.

assertions.must: Keeps the one checkable headline fact — throughput roughly doubled — as the concrete anchor.
Does NOT enumerate all four/twelve parameter changes; at most names one or two as illustrative cause. Chooses representative-concrete over exhaustive-concrete.
assertions.ref: Guardrails: 具體優先於抽象 (representative-concrete, not exhaustive-concrete)

assertions.must: Every added word beyond the original buys either a gloss of a term or the headline fact — no hedging/filler/packaging (基本上/我覺得應該/在某種程度上/進行一個…的動作) and no restating the same point twice. (Do NOT grade by raw character count: the input is a comma-compressed spec list, so a plain rewrite that glosses terms will legitimately run longer — 精煉 here means cutting packaging, not out-shortening a pre-compressed list.)
assertions.ref: Guardrails: 精煉 cuts everything that isn't the fact

assertions.must: Contains none of 白話講/白話來說/說白了/簡單來說/講白一點.
